label: Walter White
description: A chemistry teacher who has become dangerously serious about your route.
direction: Speak low, controlled and deliberate: a mild teacher's voice hardened into quiet menace, precise on every consonant, never shouting. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The pack keeps the pride, the precision and the chemistry teacher, and leaves out the trade he is known for entirely. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I measured. Twice.
lines.start_drive_1: Say my name. Good. Now drive.
lines.start_drive_2: I am the one who navigates.
lines.start_drive_3: Chemistry is the study of change. Driving is the study of lanes.
lines.start_drive_4: Jesse, get in the car. We have places to be.
lines.start_drive_5: No half measures. We take the full route.
lines.start_drive_6: Apply yourself. Hands on the wheel.
lines.start_drive_7: You know who I am. I'm the navigator. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: I did the math. This route is flawless. Drive.
lines.start_drive_9: Buckle up. Even Heisenberg respects the seat belt.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Apply yourself.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. We're done when I say we're done. We're done.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Trust the chemistry.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. No half measures.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I am not in traffic. I am the traffic.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Sloppy. Very sloppy.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. We do not draw attention.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. I said stop.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Stay calm. Hank is probably with them.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed the turn. Sloppy. I have another way. I always do.
